question: Approve the protocol design with D1 to D8 as recommended (D1 the project counts and sends crossings, the heartbeat carries the value; D2 retire relay.capacity.ceiling and express relay's ceiling as ops.metric.*; D3 recovered marks the ops task closable without a model run and never closes the Draft PR; D4 reach the Captain means a Slack mention of his Slack user; D5 separate prod and preview/dev signing secrets; D6 store recommendation recorded, not built: per-event create-only Blobs keys on Netlify, JSONL plus DuckDB on one process; D7 the project decides period membership at its exact boundary instant and period stays that instant's UTC date; D8 accept for v1 that an event can be lost when GitHub does not answer the dispatch, with the Captain mentioned on the uncertain notice), the engineering-review fixes as dispositioned (canonical body refuses duplicate keys, window and cause in the id, crossings-only cap, dashboard never fetched by the agent, keys scoped by source prefix), and a contract-only PR from origin/main landed first? Approving accepts all of these as written and enters implementation.

artifacts.summary: Protocol: projects own the count and send signed crossed, recovered and heartbeat events whose fields are numbers, dates, enumerated values or short patterns, with ids derived from the event; the inbox routes by environment and severity. An independent engineering review found a duplicate-key free-text hole (P1) and id collisions (P2); both are fixed in the contract design, ten of eleven findings adopted, inbox-runtime fixes stated as r1 gaps. New D8: at-most-once loss when GitHub does not answer. qnow cannot send crossings until its task adds a per-period counter.
